messages:
Priya: Quick ask — we need a small "snapshot" asset pack for the benchmark launch next week. Scope: landing hero, email header, 3 social tiles (static + one small Lottie/MP4), and a concise one-slide infographic for the webinar deck. Deadline: Mon EOD. cc @Jordan
Jordan: On it. Can you confirm exact output sizes and any mandatory copy lines (e.g., webinar date / CTA)?
Priya: Yes — include date (Apr 4), time, and a short tagline. Sizes: hero 1600x900 (desktop), landing hero mobile 1200x675, email header 600x200, social tiles 1200x1200. Small MP4 max 5s and <2MB.
Sam: Copy suggestions? short/mid/long variants please.
Priya: Short: "Benchmark results"; Mid: "Latency & cost benchmarks — see the results"; Long: "Register: Webinar on real-world inference latency & cost comparisons"
Jordan: Nice. I'll design space for all three CTAs and export labeled variants: CTA_short / CTA_mid / CTA_long.
Nic: Tracking — please use this UTM template: ?utm_source=bench_mar&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=mar_launch&utm_term={asset}. Also provide a manifest CSV so we can wire click maps.
Priya: Good. Filenames should follow this pattern: bench_<asset>_<size>_v1_EN.png (e.g., bench_hero_1600x900_v1_EN.png). For MP4/GIF use same but .mp4/.gif.
Jordan: Accessibility: I'll run contrast checks and produce a high-contrast variant and an inverse (white-on-dark) social variant. Any font fallback constraints?
Priya: Use our system font stack; make sure small caps don't drop below 12px effective. Also leave 25% extra line length tolerance for translations.
Jordan: For the infographic slide, do you want micro-sparklines or mini bar charts?
Priya: Sparklines please, inline with stat. Use these example numbers for layout (approx):
```
metric,median_ms,cost_per_1k
search,38,0.10
chat,110,0.29
embed,7,0.04
```
Jordan: Thanks. Will style sparklines subtle, low-ink.
Sam: Any paid promotion planned? I need final asset mapping to bidding team if so.
Priya: Possibly a small paid push. Nic will confirm.
Nic: I'll confirm spend tomorrow. For paid assets please include an ad-copy snippet in the manifest.
Jordan: Deliverables I'll upload: Figma source (with component variants), PNG/JPG exports, MP4 animated version, sprite GIF optional, and an asset-manifest.csv containing: filename, width, height, variant, CTA_label, utm, intended_use, notes.
Priya: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/benchmark-snapshot (has logos & tokens).
Jordan: Timeline: first-pass screens by tomorrow 10:30am PT; final exports by Mon EOD.
assets-bot: upload bucket reserved: marketing/bench-snapshot/1755009999/ — set visibility to team-marketing on upload. :package:
Jordan: Also adding accessibility_notes.txt with contrast ratios and suggested alt text for each image.
Priya: Great. One more ask: include a single slide PNG optimized for 72dpi that drops nicely into our webinar deck (1600x900).
Jordan: Will do. Posting first screenshots here when ready.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Nic: :white_check_mark: will post UTM sheet after CTAs locked.
